name: Lab Rats
source:
Trapped by a mad scientist, you are the subject of horrifying mental and physical experiments.  Each passing day, you struggle to escape the cold laboratory. You are torn between running for your life and succumbing to the strange allure of your kidnapper. It's only a matter of time before his dark past catches up with him and sheds light on your newfound reality. Will you unravel his secrets to survive, or will you doom yourself alongside him?

[Edited from [url=https://sayorii430.itch.io/lab-rats]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被一个疯狂的科学家困住，成为可怕的精神和身体实验的对象。日复一日，你都在努力逃离冰冷的实验室。你在逃命和屈服于绑匪的奇怪诱惑之间左右为难。他黑暗的过去追上他并揭示你新发现的现实只是时间问题。你会揭开他的秘密以求生存，还是会和他一起走向灭亡？

[编辑自[url=https://sayorii430.itch.io/lab-rats]Itch.io[/url]]
